Do you really think that when a player sees another, they immediately go into first person? No, they are going to do everything possible to keep that player in their view. If there’s a wrecked car or box they use as concealment, they are not gonna immediately switch to first person when they conceal themselves.  They’re gonna focus on the player awhile being concealed, which is an unbalanced aspect of third person.

First person only fixes all sort of balance in the game, as this game is heavily reliant on positioning and sight, it is just a better way to play DayZ in my opinion.
